# UDreamNativeWidgetHost

<!-- Generated by the DreamGUIReferenceDocs commandlet from reflection. Edit the header, not this page. -->

Inherits from [UDreamUIControl](DreamUIControl.md).

Declared in `Public/Controls/DreamNativeWidgetHost.h`.

A hole in a DreamGUI hierarchy that a UMG widget fills.

UMG's NativeWidgetHost is the reverse bridge -- a UMG widget wrapping a raw Slate one -- and this
is the same idea pointed the other way, which is the direction that matters here: the DreamGUI
tree is the outer one, and what a project needs is a way to keep a UMG screen it already owns
(an engine widget, a plugin's panel, a Slate-only editor surface) inside it.

The machinery already existed and had no control: UDreamUMGWidget renders a UUserWidget (or a bare
SWidget) to a render target and draws it as this library's own geometry, and
UDreamUMGWidgetInteraction routes pointer events into it. Both are components an author had to
know to add, wire and size. This class is the one tag that does it.

WHAT IT IS NOT: a way to mix UMG layout with DreamGUI layout. The hosted widget is drawn into a
texture at this control's size and knows nothing about what is around it -- it cannot push the
DreamGUI layout around and DreamGUI cannot reach inside it. That is the bargain the render-target
bridge makes, it is the same one UMG's own world-space widget component makes, and a control that
pretended otherwise would be lying about which layout pass owns what.

NEEDS A WORLD, like everything that instances a UserWidget: with none (a headless test, the parts
of the designer that build no world) the host node exists, sized and placed, and simply draws
nothing. That is the same answer UDreamListViewBase gives for a row template class.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Category | In the details panel | From Blueprint | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `WidgetClass` | `TSubclassOf<UUserWidget>` | Native Widget Host | yes | `GetWidgetClass` / `SetWidgetClass` | The UMG widget class to instance and draw. Null draws nothing, which is an empty hole. |
| `ResolutionScale` | `float` | Native Widget Host | yes | `SetResolutionScale` | How many render-target pixels one local unit is worth. One is pixel-for-pixel. |
| `BackgroundColor` | `FLinearColor` | Native Widget Host | yes | `SetBackgroundColor` | What shows through where the hosted widget draws nothing. Transparent by default. |
| `HostNode` | `TObjectPtr<UDreamWidget>` | Native Widget Host | - | read only | The node whose visual is the bridge. Public because everything under a control is reachable. |
| `HostVisual` | `TObjectPtr<UDreamUMGWidget>` | Native Widget Host | - | read only | The bridge itself, for everything this control does not wrap. |

## Functions

| Function | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `UUserWidget* GetHostedWidget()` | pure | The instance the bridge made, or null while there is no world or no class. |
| `TSubclassOf<UUserWidget> GetWidgetClass()` | pure | Get Widget Class |
| `void SetBackgroundColor(FLinearColor InBackgroundColor)` | callable | What the render target is cleared to behind the hosted widget. Pushed to the host visual at once. |
| `void SetResolutionScale(float InResolutionScale)` | callable | Render-target pixels per local unit of the host. Pushed to the host visual at once. |
| `void SetWidgetClass(TSubclassOf<UUserWidget> InWidgetClass)` | callable | Replace the hosted class and re-instance it. Null empties the hole. |
